name: Sweet Corn Edamame Soup
ingredients: 1 tsp cornflour mixed with 2 tbsp water
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion and garlic for 3 minutes without browning.
Add the corn and edamame and stir for 2 minutes.
Add the stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend half the soup, leaving the rest chunky, and return to the pot.
Stir in the cornflour paste, simmer for 2 minutes, then add pepper, salt and spring onions.
note: Edamame lifts the protein to around 11 g per bowl.
